durations.actual_delivery_days: normalized customer delivery date - normalized purchase date
durations.promised_lead_days: normalized estimated delivery date - normalized purchase date
durations.promise_error_days: normalized customer delivery date - normalized estimated delivery date

models.spline: natural cubic regression spline with centering constraint absorbed for identifiability with the intercept
models.model_a: low_review_2 ~ cr(actual_delivery_days, df=4, constraints='center') + purchase-month fixed effects
models.model_b: low_review_2 ~ cr(actual_delivery_days, df=4, constraints='center') + promise-error group + purchase-month fixed effects
models.model_c: low_review_2 ~ cr(promised_lead_days, df=4, constraints='center') + promise-error group + purchase-month fixed effects
models.sparse_month_label: pooled sparse purchase months (<500 orders each)

support.curve_grid: inclusive integer days from ceil(p05) to floor(p95)

contrasts.speed: within on-promised-date: adjusted P(D75)-P(D25), durations from on-date orders
contrasts.late_4_7: adjusted P(4-7 days late)-P(on promised date) at deterministic common-support duration
contrasts.late_8_plus: adjusted P(>=8 days late)-P(on promised date) at deterministic common-support duration

sensitivities: selected reviews at or after actual customer-delivery timestamp
